titles.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to remove the limitation on deductions for theft losses involving fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation and to allow such deductions without regard to whether the taxpayer itemizes other deductions.

To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to remove the limitation on deductions for theft losses involving fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation and to allow such deductions without regard to whether the taxpayer itemizes other deductions.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
